label: H.R. 6472
title: Territorial Student Access to Higher Education Act

items.snippet: This bill requires public institutions of higher education that participate in federal student aid programs to charge no more than in-state tuition and fee rates to…

…that participate in federal student aid programs to charge no more than in-state tuition and fee rates to students who are residents of Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands, American Samoa, or the U.S. Virgin Islands, provided…

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
